verifications.note: An EACOP news release from October 1, 2026. Auditors general from Tanzania and Uganda visited the marine terminal in Tanga. It says the project is about 93% complete and that First Oil is expected in early 2027.

A Daily News (Tanzania) article from 2026 quoting the Tanzania Petroleum Development Corporation. It says EACOP is 92.7% complete, crude should reach Chongoleani in Tanga in February 2027, and the first tanker loading is expected in March 2027.

A Voice of Nigeria article from September 15, 2026, on Uganda's parliament. It says the 1,443 km EACOP will be ready to receive crude by mid-December 2026 and first commercial oil is expected before the end of June 2027. It lists earlier targets of end 2025 and July 2026, and says FID was announced in February 2022.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The start year moves from 2025 to 2027. EACOP said in October 2026 that first oil is expected in early 2027. Tanzania's oil company expects the first tanker loading in March 2027, and Uganda's parliament was told first commercial oil will come before the end of June 2027. The month is left blank because the sources give dates from February to June 2027. StartYearEarliest also reads 2025 and may need the same change.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The delay is confirmed. The final investment decision release planned first oil by 2025, and officials later promised end 2025 and then July 2026. First oil is now expected in 2027.

verifications.note: An Oil & Gas Journal article from October 12, 2015. It says Uganda, Tanzania, the Tanzania Petroleum Development Corporation and Total E&P Uganda signed a memorandum of understanding on development principles for a crude oil pipeline from Hoima, Uganda, to Tanga Port, Tanzania.

A Pipeline Journal article from October 14, 2015. It says the two governments signed an agreement to study a pipeline from the oil fields near Hoima to the port of Tanga, as an alternative to the Kenya routes.

A TanzaniaInvest article from March 9, 2016, titled Tanzania and Uganda reach agreement to develop Hoima-Tanga oil pipeline. It says a memorandum of understanding for the pipeline was signed in October 2015.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The proposal date moves from 2006 to October 2015. 2006 is the year oil was found at Lake Albert. In October 2015 Uganda, Tanzania, the Tanzania Petroleum Development Corporation and Total E&P Uganda signed a memorandum of understanding for a pipeline from Hoima to Tanga. Oil & Gas Journal and Pipeline Journal both reported it that month, and TanzaniaInvest gives the same month. Uganda chose the Tanzania route in April 2016, which is when Earth Insight says the pipeline was first proposed. That is the route decision, not the first proposal. Uganda discussed export pipelines from about 2011 to 2015, but those plans ran through Kenya to Lamu or Mombasa, so they are not counted here. The recorded reference is a Citizen article about the Tazama pipeline that does not mention EACOP.

verifications.note: A Daily Monitor article from April 2, 2024, titled New jobs in pipeline as construction starts. It says construction of EACOP is taking shape in Uganda and Tanzania.

The EACOP milestones page. It lists the route announcement in 2016, the foundation stone at Chongoleani in Tanga Region in 2017, the establishment of EACOP Ltd and the final investment decision on February 1, 2022, construction licenses in 2023, and the first pipe weld on September 4, 2024.

A Chanzo article from June 30, 2026. Tanzania's energy minister said EACOP was 86% built with the first oil shipment expected in January 2027. It says welding began in September 2024 and puts the total cost at about 5.6 billion dollars.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The construction year moves from 2025 to 2024. The Daily Monitor reported in April 2024 that construction had started, and the first pipe weld was on September 4, 2024. The recorded Earth Insight page is from 2025 and does not say when construction began. Construction licenses were issued in early 2023, so 2023 is another possible reading.

verifications.note: An EACOP news release from October 1, 2026. Auditors general from Tanzania and Uganda visited the marine terminal in Tanga. It says the project is about 93% complete and that First Oil is expected in early 2027.

A Daily News (Tanzania) article from 2026 quoting the Tanzania Petroleum Development Corporation. It says EACOP is 92.7% complete, crude should reach Chongoleani in Tanga in February 2027, and the first tanker loading is expected in March 2027.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The pipeline is still under construction. It was about 93% complete in October 2026.
